# Vendored: Lovelace et al. `dcscaling` (laws.py, fit.py)

Copied unmodified from `github.com/justinlovelace/data-constrained-scaling` (MIT), snapshot taken 2026-10-07 (first
content commit). Used only by `code/step2_sens.py` for sensitivities S2 and S3 (`additive_2p`, `additive_4p`,
`muennighoff_d`, `muennighoff_dn`), each fitted on top of our own Phase 1 base. The preregistered primary fit
(`step2_fit.py`) uses the Step 0 reimplementation, not this code.
